recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current authoritative Group source satisfies FHIR-26648; FHIR-24848 should remain supporting context rather than being treated as separately reconciled by this seed commit.
issue_request: FHIR-26648 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I R5 issue asking that Group allow collections of Organization resources because Group.member.entity did not include Organization; the accepted resolution said this was already covered by FHIR-24848.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-26648 or J#26648. The requested source state appears to have been applied by commit 272e3fb71ecb0d87630a48101b00015f0f18b038 for J#24848, which added the organization Group.type code and Organization as a Group.member.entity target profile.
additional_context: FHIR-24848 was a broader Published/Not Persuasive with Modification decision to align Group with passive participant-like members. FHIR-I minutes from 2020-03-30 record FHIR-26648 as persuasive and already covered by FHIR-24848. FHIR-28107 later independently confirmed Location and Organization groups and is already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-25733 was retracted as addressed by FHIR-26648.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Group is active in source/fhir.ini, source/group/codesystem-group-type.xml defines organization, source/group/structuredefinition-Group.xml includes Organization in Group.type guidance and Group.member.entity targets, and source/group/group-notes.xml preserves the passive-use limitation for groups of Organizations.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-26648's resolution explicitly relied on this broader Group participant-scope decision, and its implementation commit added Organization support.
Later Published/Persuasive issue independently allowed groups of Location and Organization; already represented on the combined branch by 2a959199b65b949a5b793d55536127c04b0b5d3e.
Earlier question about groups of organizations was retracted by the reporter as addressed by FHIR-26648.

evidence_items.summary: Group is active in fhir.ini; the Group type CodeSystem defines organization; Group.type documentation mentions Organization; Group.member.entity permits Organization; usage notes keep groups of Organizations passive.
evidence_items.learned: The authoritative source already satisfies FHIR-26648 without adding redundant narrative.
